_comment: WO-5 step one, the rented-GPU timing session. TIMING ONLY - NOT A RESULT OF RECORD. Prepared
2026-10-07 under D-050 (the owner chose to prepare the RunPod Secure Cloud RTX 4090 session);
the spend itself still needs the owner's explicit approval at the session (D-047). Nothing is
evaluated, exported or logged to MLflow by the run; the fit is interrupted after the budget. ADR
0020's cell 0b on cuda: hidden 64, 2 blocks, 2 heads, feed-forward 256, dropout 0.2, history 50,
sampled softmax with 1,024 negatives, 512 examples per step, Adam 1e-3, seed 42, the objective
of record (strict-prefix-final-position-v1), the full dataset, early stopping off. Timed by
`python -m src.training.sasrec_timing run`: 180 s of steady-state stepping after 20 warm-up
steps (the WO-4 method's warm-up, excluded), then the steady mean x 38,554 steps per pass.
epochs is 5, the cell's ceiling, only so no pass boundary can end the fit before the budget
does. The protocol hash is the no-cohort hash of the full split.train, pinned so a machine
reading different data fails rather than times it. References: WO-4's cell 0b pair, which ran
this step shape on the CPU and on mps.
result_status: timing only - not a result of record

cpu.basis: measured: WO-4 cell 0b CPU pilot, passes 3-5 alone, 2026-10-05
